name: Vicky Sharma
player_statement:
A complete player, Vicky Sharma has made a big mark in cricket. With 17 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 42*, with an average of 14.29 and a quick strike rate of 143.88. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 13 sixes and 14 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 11.4 overs, taking 10 wickets at an economy rate of 9.26. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
